sentences.text_target: Mark wakes up early when his alarm clock rings loudly in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːrk weɪks ʌp ˈɜːrli wɛn hɪz əˈlɑːrm klɑːk rɪŋz ˈlaʊdli ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Mark se réveille tôt lorsque son réveil sonne fort le matin.

sentences.text_target: He opens his eyes slowly and looks at himself in the mirror.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈoʊpənz hɪz aɪz ˈsloʊli ənd lʊks ət hɪmˈsɛlf ɪn ðə ˈmɪrər/
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre lentement les yeux et se regarde dans le miroir.

sentences.text_target: His posture feels somewhat stiff because he slept poorly.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈpɑːstʃər fiːlz ˈsʌmwʌt stɪf bɪˈkɒz hi slɛpt ˈpʊrli/
sentences.text_native: Sa posture semble un peu raide parce qu'il a mal dormi.

sentences.text_target: He stands beside the bed and stretches his arms above his head.
sentences.phonetic: /hi stændz bɪˈsaɪd ðə bɛd ənd ˈstrɛtʃɪz hɪz ɑːrmz əˈbʌv hɪz hɛd/
sentences.text_native: Il se tient à côté du lit et étire ses bras au-dessus de sa tête.

sentences.text_target: All his joints and ligaments crack as he moves his body.
sentences.phonetic: /ɔːl hɪz dʒɔɪnts ənd ˈlɪɡəmənts kræk æz hi muːvz hɪz ˈbɑːdi/
sentences.text_native: Toutes ses articulations et ses ligaments craquent lorsqu'il bouge son corps.

sentences.text_target: He walks carefully to the bathroom to brush his teeth with toothpaste.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks ˈkɛrfəli tuː ðə ˈbæθruːm tuː brʌʃ hɪz tiːθ wɪð ˈtuːθpeɪst/
sentences.text_native: Il marche prudemment vers la salle de bains pour se brosser les dents avec du dentifrice.

sentences.text_target: Then he washes his face thoroughly with cool water and soap.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hi ˈwɑːʃɪz hɪz feɪs ˈθɜːrəli wɪð kuːl ˈwɔːtər ənd soʊp/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il se lave soigneusement le visage à l'eau fraîche et au savon.

sentences.text_target: His brain starts to activate as he thinks about today's schedule.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz breɪn stɑːrts tuː ˈæktɪveɪt æz hi θɪŋks əˈbaʊt təˈdeɪz ˈskɛdʒuːl/
sentences.text_native: Son cerveau commence à s'activer alors qu'il pense au programme d'aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: He eats a nutritious breakfast and drinks a warm cup of coffee.
sentences.phonetic: /hi iːts ə nuˈtrɪʃəs ˈbrɛkfəst ənd drɪŋks ə wɔːrm kʌp ʌv ˈkɑːfi/
sentences.text_native: Il mange un petit-déjeuner nutritif et boit une tasse de café chaud.

sentences.text_target: The food enters his stomach where digestion and absorption begin.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə fuːd ˈɛntərz hɪz ˈstʌmək wɛr daɪˈdʒɛstʃən ənd əbˈzɔːrpʃən bɪˈɡɪn/
sentences.text_native: La nourriture entre dans son estomac où la digestion et l'absorption commencent.

sentences.text_target: Glucose converts into energy to support his physical metabolism.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɡluːkoʊs kənˈvɜːrts ˈɪntuː ˈɛnərdʒi tuː səˈpɔːrt hɪz ˈfɪzɪkl məˈtæbəlɪzəm/
sentences.text_native: Le glucose se convertit en énergie pour soutenir son métabolisme physique.

sentences.text_target: His heart pumps blood through various vessels across his chest.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz hɑːrt pʌmps blʌd θruː ˈvɛriəs ˈvɛsəlz əˈkrɒs hɪz tʃɛst/
sentences.text_native: Son cœur pompe le sang à travers divers vaisseaux dans sa poitrine.

sentences.text_target: His pulse accelerates slightly as he leaves the house.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz pʌls ækˈsɛləreɪts ˈslaɪtli æz hi liːvz ðə haʊs/
sentences.text_native: Son pouls s'accélère légèrement lorsqu'il quitte la maison.

sentences.text_target: He takes a deep breath of fresh air into his lungs outside.
sentences.phonetic: /hi teɪks ə diːp brɛθ ʌv frɛʃ ɛr ˈɪntuː hɪz lʌŋz ˈaʊtsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Il prend une profonde inspiration d'air frais dans ses poumons dehors.

sentences.text_target: He walks to work, moving his legs and knees with steady steps.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks tuː wɜːrk, ˈmuːvɪŋ hɪz lɛɡz ənd niːz wɪð ˈstɛdi stɛps/
sentences.text_native: Il marche pour aller travailler, bougeant ses jambes et ses genoux à pas réguliers.

sentences.text_target: At the office, he sits at his desk in front of a computer screen.
sentences.phonetic: /æt ði ˈɔːfɪs, hi sɪts æt hɪz dɛsk ɪn frʌnt ʌv ə kəmˈpjuːtər skriːn/
sentences.text_native: Au bureau, il s'assoit à son bureau devant un écran d'ordinateur.

sentences.text_target: He blinks frequently because his eyes feel dry from the light.
sentences.phonetic: /hi blɪŋks ˈfriːkwəntli bɪˈkɒz hɪz aɪz fiːl draɪ frɒm ðə laɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il cligne des yeux fréquemment parce que ses yeux sont secs à cause de la lumière.

sentences.text_target: He swallows some water from a glass to soothe his throat.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈswɑːloʊz sʌm ˈwɔːtər frɒm ə ɡlæs tuː suːð hɪz θroʊt/
sentences.text_native: Il avale un peu d'eau d'un verre pour apaiser sa gorge.

sentences.text_target: Busy meetings and phone calls create mental tension all morning.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈbɪzi ˈmiːtɪŋz ənd foʊn kɔːlz kriˈeɪt ˈmɛntl ˈtɛnʃən ɔːl ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Des réunions chargées et des appels téléphoniques créent une tension mentale toute la matinée.

sentences.text_target: That stress puts extra strain on his neck and shoulders.
sentences.phonetic: /ðæt strɛs pʊts ˈɛkstrə streɪn ɒn hɪz nɛk ənd ˈʃoʊldərz/
sentences.text_native: Ce stress exerce une tension supplémentaire sur son cou et ses épaules.

sentences.text_target: By afternoon, mild fatigue begins to affect his daily performance.
sentences.phonetic: /baɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn, maɪld fəˈtiːɡ bɪˈɡɪnz tuː əˈfɛkt hɪz ˈdeɪli pərˈfɔːrməns/
sentences.text_native: L'après-midi venu, une légère fatigue commence à affecter ses performances quotidiennes.

sentences.text_target: His sweat glands react when the office temperature rises slightly.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz swɛt ɡlændz riˈækt wɛn ði ˈɔːfɪs ˈtɛmprətʃər ˈraɪzɪz ˈslaɪtli/
sentences.text_native: Ses glandes sudoripares réagissent lorsque la température du bureau monte légèrement.

sentences.text_target: Proper hydration helps maintain his overall wellness and vitality.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈprɑːpər haɪˈdreɪʃən hɛlps mɛnˈteɪn hɪz ˈoʊvərɔːl ˈwɛlnəs ənd vəˈtæləti/
sentences.text_native: Une hydratation adéquate aide à maintenir son bien-être général et sa vitalité.

sentences.text_target: He exercises after work to maintain his strength and fitness.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈɛksərsaɪzɪz ˈæftər wɜːrk tuː mɛnˈteɪn hɪz strɛŋθ ənd ˈfɪtnəs/
sentences.text_native: Il fait de l'exercice après le travail pour maintenir sa force et sa forme physique.

sentences.text_target: Physical activity improves his health and prevents physical exhaustion.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfɪzɪkl ækˈtɪvəti ɪmˈpruːvz hɪz hɛlθ ənd prɪˈvɛnts ˈfɪzɪkl ɪɡˈzɔːstʃən/
sentences.text_native: L'activité physique améliore sa santé et prévient l'épuisement physique.

sentences.text_target: He takes a healthy diet with vitamins to aid tissue healing.
sentences.phonetic: /hi teɪks ə ˈhɛlθi ˈdaɪət wɪð ˈvaɪtəmɪnz tuː eɪd ˈtɪʃuː ˈhiːlɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il adopte une alimentation saine avec des vitamines pour aider à la guérison des tissus.

sentences.text_target: Back home, he stretches his back and hips to relieve sore muscles.
sentences.phonetic: /bæk hoʊm, hi ˈstrɛtʃɪz hɪz bæk ənd hɪps tuː rɪˈliːv sɔːr ˈmʌsəlz/
sentences.text_native: De retour à la maison, il étire son dos et ses hanches pour soulager ses muscles endoloris.

sentences.text_target: He needs good sleep and rest to recharge his nervous system.
sentences.phonetic: /hi niːdz ɡʊd sliːp ənd rɛst tuː ˌriːˈtʃɑːrdʒ hɪz ˈnɜːrvəs ˈsɪstəm/
sentences.text_native: Il a besoin d'un bon sommeil et de repos pour recharger son système nerveux.

sentences.text_target: Rest allows his bones and whole body to recover completely.
sentences.phonetic: /rɛst əˈlaʊz hɪz boʊnz ənd hoʊl ˈbɑːdi tuː rɪˈkʌvər kəmˈpliːtli/
sentences.text_native: Le repos permet à ses os et à tout son corps de récupérer complètement.

sentences.text_target: By following this balanced routine, he ensures optimal body function.
sentences.phonetic: /baɪ ˈfɑːloʊɪŋ ðɪs ˈbælənst ruːˈtiːn, hi ɪnˈʃʊrz ˈɑːptɪməl ˈbɑːdi ˈfʌŋkʃən/
sentences.text_native: En suivant cette routine équilibrée, il assure le fonctionnement optimal de son corps.
